findings.note: tests/e2e-mutation-incremental.mjs is a large (364-line) local-only proof script explicitly marked "Not run in CI" and needs network access; it is exercised manually rather than by an automated gate, so its own coverage is unverified by CI. Acceptable given its stated purpose as a manual real-Stryker proof (spec §7.1, §11.7); no correctness issue found in the reviewed logic (LoadMutationContext, view maps, freshness wiring all look consistent with reviewers/mutation.go).
